guidance.statement: Margin trajectory at bottom in Q2, neutral to positive outlook ahead
guidance.quote: The trajectory will be upward from the next quarter onwards.

guidance.statement: 25bps repo increase in October should be factored into P&L by December
guidance.quote: 25 basis points change...in October should largely be factored in by December.

guidance.statement: Target operating band 110-120%, ideally 115%, needed for sustainable growth
guidance.quote: we would like to operate between 110 and 120

guidance.statement: Employee count to remain flat, then increase in 3-4 years as productivity matures
guidance.quote: remain flat and probably...start to increase over maybe three, four years' time

guidance.statement: Retail ex-agri loan growth improving; 20-30% annual runoff requires continued acceleration
guidance.quote: across the next 2 quarters, you will see that change coming through

guidance.statement: New MD to present perspective on growth, margins, quality and productivity soon
guidance.quote: I will soon present a perspective on growth, margins, quality and productivity

delivered.statement: Deposits increased 18.8% YoY reported basis; CASA grew 10.8%; retail CASA 11.2% vs 9% prior year
Total AUM grew 15.3% YoY; retail disbursements crossed Rs 90,000cr vs Rs 76,000cr Q1
Retail ex-agri EOP growth 11.2% Sept'26 vs 9.1% June'26; new credit cards 1.4M, up 19% QoQ
Business banking grew 28% YoY; Sept'26 MSME/mid-market growth 23.5% YoY; ECLGS Rs 41,000cr highest
Added 1.7M liability relationships in Q2, 25% higher than Q1, 33% higher than Q4 prior year
GNPA 1.11%, down 13bps YoY; credit costs 44bps; risk weights 69% of total assets
ROA 1.8%; quarterly PAT Rs 19.5 billion, +12.7% YoY excluding trading gains
Product delivery TATs down 10-15%; service TATs down 30%; customer visits per resource up 50%

themes: Operational rigor and daily productivity gains in retail/MSME sales and service delivery
AI and digital technology embedded across customer experience, fraud prevention, collections
Balance sheet rebalancing toward retail/MSME growth, moderating corporate exposure
Liability franchise expansion via branch productivity and deposit relationship acquisition
Industry-leading asset quality maintained despite credit growth acceleration
Rate cycle inflection: margin bottom reached, tailwinds from 25bps repo increase
risks: Large extraordinary deposit outflows from corporate and inherited FCNR balances masking retail momentum
Cost of funds pressure from FCNR deposit mix and time deposit substitution of legacy liabilities
Monsoon shortfall impact on agricultural loan portfolio and MSME rural exposure
Insurance commission rate cuts under draft norms pressuring bancassurance income
analyst_pushback: Why margin decline similar to peers despite lower corporate growth? Kaizad: retail backbook runoff 20-30% annually; improvement expected next 2 quarters.
When will retail deposit proportion increase? Sashi: extraordinary outflows masking momentum; structural adjustments and alternate non-deposit strategies coming soon.
LCR at 113% below 110-115% target—constraint on growth? Srini: used for growth dynamics; need to maintain ~115% for sustained loan growth.
Why not reduce lower-yield corporate assets like other banks? Kaizad: relationship management more important; certain retail products match wholesale returns.
tone_evidence: Confident on momentum, asset quality, tech; defensive on margin pressure, deposit mix, outflows masking growth.
